# orionbelt_agent (Resource)

Registers an agent (a machine reached through a reverse tunnel) and renders its configuration. Only the public key is sent; the private key stays on the host or in your secret store.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The private key stays on the host: private_key_command fetches it at boot.
resource "orionbelt_agent" "web" {
  name                = "web-1"
  public_key          = var.agent_public_key
  private_key_command = "aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id agents/web-1 --query SecretString --output text"
}

# cloud_init can be passed straight to an instance's user_data.
output "web_user_data" {
  value     = orionbelt_agent.web.cloud_init
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Agent and machine name. Changing it replaces the agent.
- `public_key` (String) Agent's SSH public key in authorized_keys format. Changing it replaces the agent.

### Optional

- `archive_on_destroy` (Boolean) Deactivate instead of deleting on destroy. Deleting also deletes the machine's session recordings. Default true.
- `gateway_host` (String) Gateway SSH host agents dial. Defaults to the gateway's advertised public SSH host.
- `gateway_host_key` (String) Pins the gateway's SSH host key (authorized_keys format) when it has no host CA.
- `gateway_port` (Number) Gateway SSH port agents dial. Defaults to the advertised port.
- `hostname` (String) Address the agent connects to locally. Defaults to name.
- `install_version` (String) Agent release cloud-init installs, e.g. v1.4.0. Default: latest.
- `port` (Number) Local SSH port on the target. Default 22.
- `private_key_command` (String, Sensitive) Shell command that prints the agent's private key on the host at first boot, e.g. reading AWS Secrets Manager. Required for cloud_init.
- `tags` (Map of String)

### Read-Only

- `agent_yaml` (String) Contents of /etc/orion-belt/agent.yaml.
- `cloud_init` (String, Sensitive) #cloud-config user data that installs and starts the agent. Null without private_key_command. Sensitive because it embeds private_key_command.
- `host_ca_public_key` (String) Gateway host CA the agent trusts.
- `host_certificate` (String) Host certificate the gateway issued for this agent, when it runs an SSH CA.
- `id` (String) Machine ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an agent by its ID. Imported agents are archived on destroy.
terraform import orionbelt_agent.web <agent_id>
```
